text:
rachel: Quick sync: planning a micro-launch next week to test activation hooks tied to webinar attendance. idea is to split inbound into three flows and see which drives fastest time-to-first-success. flows: (1) 'tease' email + 40 starter credits + 1 prompt template, (2) 'clinic' invite (webinar heavy) + 100 credits + office hours slot, (3) 'guided' in-product onboarding with no upfront credits but an interactive quickstart and sample promptpack. primary metric = time_to_first_success (hrs), secondary = 7d retention + token spend. budget cap $3.5k.

omar: i'm on routing. prefer randomize at signup and persist. also want a guard: only users with company email and not already converted. can growth-bot enforce? @growth-bot

growth-bot: experiment created: id plg-micro-2026-04-05-routes. assignment rule: randomized at signup, saved to user.attributes.experiment[plg_micro]. grant triggers: on first_success event for flows that include credits. whitelist: email_domain != gmail/yahoo. doc link: https://redwood.internal/experiments/plg-micro-2026-04-05

devon: analytics ask: please record cohort_id, arm_name, webinar_attended boolean, first_success_ts, and referral_source. i'll run survival curves. also let's capture whether they opened the onboarding checklist.

carla: creative plan: two email sequences per arm. for clinic arm we send a 'claim your office hours' CTA. will craft subject lines and 3 micro-variations for hero screenshot. ETA Tue noon.

rachel: nice. quick UX thought: for the guided in-product flow, surface one sample template inline after signup and a 'try now' button that calls the sandbox endpoint. reduces friction.

omar: ops: going to put a soft cap of 50 credits per user and global spend cap set to $3.5k. also recommend throttling to avoid credit farming; grant only once and expire credits after 14 days.

syed: prompt pack checklist: include 4 vertical-focused prompts (customer-support, code-assist, ideation, marketing-copy) and 2 short examples each. i'll sanitize any PII.

carla: email cadence: immediate claim email, 24h reminder, 48h final nudge + webinar invite. social teaser the morning before webinar.

devon: experiment analysis plan: run pairwise comparisons vs control (guided) for time_to_first_success and logistic regression controlling for org_size and referral_source. will drop users with no activity after 7 days.

rachel: ops payload for grants (put in lambda): ```json
{"experiment_id":"plg-micro-2026-04-05-routes","arm":"clinic","credits":100,"cap_per_user":50,"expires_days":14}
```

omar: I'll implement routing and add event tags: experiment_id, arm, grant_status. will also emit webhook to analytics on grant.

growth-bot: ramp plan scheduled: start with 200 randomized users Mon 09:00 UTC, monitor budget burn. alert channel: #marketing-ops if spend > $500 in first 24h.

carla: posting copy + img comps in #marketing in 30m. please react with :eyes: when reviewed.

syed: i'll post sanitized prompt samples in this thread when ready.

devon: assigning: @devon leads analysis, @omar infra/routing, @syed prompts, @carla creative. report out next Tues.

rachel: perfect. keep updates here and tag when infra complete. launch Monday morning if all green. thanks team :rocket:
